parole.testo: Borrowed from English bar (2), from Ancient Greek βάρος (báros, “weight”).
From for- (“pre-, pro-”) + rit (“writ, writing”). Calque of English program, which is derived from Ancient Greek πρό (pró, “before”) + γράμμα (grámma, “writing”).

Composed samur (“same”) + -sæta (“one who sits, is located”), the latter part perhaps in this case newly derived from sæti (“seat, position, place”).
